help.Getting started:
Choose a creature, adjust size and speed, then Summon. One mount at a time; summoning another replaces it. The menu closes when loading finishes.

Use Shift+F5 to summon mounts. Animals summoned with F5 are ordinary companions and cannot be ridden.
help.Orders: Dismount, face your creature, then use {2} for text or {3} for voice. Ask it to follow, wait, approach, look at you, attack nearby enemies or leave. Spoken replies Off uses local typed commands only.
help.Riding:
Use {1} nearby to mount or dismount. WASD moves; hold Shift to run. Combat dismounts you automatically. Peaceful animals cannot fight. First person follows the main mod camera setting.

Use Shift+F5 to summon mounts. Animals summoned with F5 are ordinary companions and cannot be ridden.
help.Settings: Size and speed: 50% to 250%. Rider offsets apply live. Voices Auto uses English Kokoro for English UI and multilingual voices otherwise. Interface language can follow the main mod or be selected here.
help.Troubleshooting: Close other menus first. Move closer or into open ground if riding fails. Both main-mod downloads are required. Restart after installing this add-on. For support, use the main mod Help > Copy logs.
